About

HALFpipe is an open-source software developed by the ENIGMA (Enhancing NeuroImaging Genetics through Meta-Analysis) consortium.

For more information about the project, please see the ENGIMA functional image processing protocol webpage

Related ressources

How to cite

HALFpipe

Waller, L., Erk, S., Pozzi, E., Toenders, Y. J., Haswell, C. C., Büttner, M., Thompson, P. M., Schmaal, L., Morey, R. A., Walter, H., & Veer, I. M. (2022). ENIGMA HALFpipe: Interactive, reproducible, and efficient analysis for resting-state and task-based fMRI data. Human brain mapping, 43(9), 2727–2742. https://doi.org/10.1002/hbm.25829

Software

HALFpipe relies on tools from well-established neuroimaging software packages, we strongly urge users to acknowledge these tools when publishing results obtained with HALFpipe:

  • ANTs
  • FreeSurfer
  • FSL
  • AFNI
  • nipype

Seed Atlas
